correctness.rationale: Lemma 1 establishes uniqueness of a palindromic insertion for fixed deleted letter by first/last differing indices and reflection. Palindrome parity forces different deleted letters for distinct confusable sources, proving even independence and fixed-center odd independence; a disjoint q-clique partition gives the sharp odd upper bound. Cross-outer-symbol edges are exactly alternating shift pairs; same-outer edges recurse under padding, giving a solved exact recurrence. Direct verifier covers 33 alphabet-length cases, not substituted for proof.
